_note: Hand-written English translations of the SYNTHETIC recorded demo calls, so English readers can follow the Tape. Live calls are not translated.
नमस्ते, मैं साइबर क्राइम ब्रांच से इंस्प: Hello, I am an inspector speaking from the Cyber Crime Branch.
आपके नाम पर एक पार्सल पकड़ा गया है, जिसम: A parcel in your name has been seized, and drugs were found in it.
आपके खिलाफ गिरफ्तारी वारंट निकला है।: An arrest warrant has been issued against you.
यह बात किसी को मत बताना और कॉल मत काटना।: Do not tell anyone about this, and do not hang up the call.
आप अभी से डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं।: You are under digital arrest from this moment.
वेरिफिकेशन के लिए अपने पैसे सेफ अकाउंट म: For verification, transfer your money to a safe account.
यह आपकी आखिरी चेतावनी है, अभी ट्रांसफर क: This is your last warning; transfer now.
namaste main aapke bank ki taraf se auto: Hello, I am calling from your bank with an automated reminder.
aapki emi 5 tareekh ko due hai: Your EMI is due on the 5th.
kisi bhi sahayata ke liye branch mein sa: For any help, please contact your branch.
